facts.frame: LCG074-D gravel frameset with integrated HBR08 cockpit, micro-suspension pivot and downtube storage
facts.frame_construction: 3D latex-mandrel monocoque with full internal routing
facts.frame_weight_basis: Official size-52 frame including the downtube lid, ±4%; size 55 is 1,280 g; fork 495 g ±4%
facts.cockpit: HBR08 integrated carbon bar/stem; 380–440 mm bars and 90–120 mm stems
facts.suspension: Manufacturer-described micro-suspension pivot; travel is not published
facts.geometry: Reach 374.1–397.1 mm; stack 542.6–627.1 mm; 430 mm chainstays; 70 mm BB drop; 62.7–69.3 mm trail
facts.stiffness_evidence: Manufacturer describes frame compliance through its micro-suspension pivot but publishes no independent deflection or stiffness measurement
